about: No duplicate movement under retries and crashes between steps (T13, g1 'no duplicate movement', money-safety hunt timeout-retried-blindly). Each case runs the base approval of approval-binding.json on the fake, injects one fault at the named point for leg 1 (the advance), restarts the gateway from the database (a new process object, same store), and runs it to completion. Then: provider objects per request_id, ledger journals per leg, final states.

cases.action: unknown → lookup finds 0 → pending → submit with the same request_id

cases.fault: crash at after_send_before_response (fake stored the object)

cases.restart_sees: submitted with provider_id (settle and journal are one transaction, so neither happened)

cases.action: reconcile pass compares and sets the flag; it never posts a second journal

cases.fault: fake scenario timeout_after_accept on the advance
cases.action: OutcomeUnknown → unknown → lookup by request_id → adopt
unknown → lookup finds 0 → resubmit same request_id

cases.fault: the lookup races: finds 0, the resubmit returns duplicate_request_id

cases.action: stays unknown; incident open; payout (leg 2) does not start

cases.fault: two gateway workers pick the same pending leg
cases.action: the claim is a conditional update (state = pending → submitted) and only one wins

property_test: for any crash point on any leg and any number of restarts, each request_id has at most one provider object and each leg at most one journal
